bgremove.mdd: Let me lift the background off.
bgremove.opt.despill: Remove background colour left on the edge
bgremove.opt.pick: Click the background to pick it
bgremove.status.badImage: Could not read that as an image
bgremove.status.nothing: Nothing was removed — loosen the threshold or click the background to pick it
bgremove.status.tooMuch: Removed {n}% — that is too loose, lower the threshold
bgremove.note.limits: Solid or near-solid backgrounds only (ID photos, product shots, scans). It does not recognise people or objects — that needs a machine-learning model this site does not ship. It fills from the edges, so a subject the same colour as the background is not punched through.
